quiz.question: 哪個敘述最直接說明「完成防禦驗收」的核心原理？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement most directly explains complete defensive acceptance?
options: 有備份檔案不等於可成功復原，需實際測試。
離開團隊或裝置遺失時，存取權需及時撤銷。
安全驗收需要正向功能與負向授權測試同時通過。
optionsEn: Possessing backup files does not prove recoverability; restore tests are necessary.
Access needs timely revocation when a user leaves or loses a device.
Acceptance needs both functional and negative authorization tests.
quiz.explanation: 安全驗收需要正向功能與負向授權測試同時通過。
quiz.explanationEn: Acceptance needs both functional and negative authorization tests.

existing.title: 安全啟動與韌體信任鏈
existing.titleEn: Secure boot and firmware chains of trust
existing.summary: 從信任根、映像驗證與金鑰權限，建立能拒絕未授權啟動、處理更新並保留可信復原路徑的設計。
existing.summaryEn: Design a boot chain with roots of trust, image verification, key authority, authenticated updates and a trusted recovery path.

stages.title: 信任架構
stages.description: 盤點啟動路徑與授權，不把所有韌體保護都等同 UEFI Secure Boot。
stages.descriptionEn: Inventory boot paths and authority without equating all firmware protection with UEFI Secure Boot.

steps.title: 盤點啟動元件與信任邊界
steps.titleEn: Inventory boot components and trust boundaries
steps.objective: 畫出韌體、載入器、核心及每次驗證先於執行的邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Map firmware, loader and kernel with verification boundaries before execution.
steps.instruction: 在隔離的紙上模型排列信任根、平台韌體、UEFI 載入器與作業系統核心。為每次交接標明驗證者、被驗證資料與失敗處置；把硬體韌體保護與 UEFI 映像政策分開。
steps.instructionEn: In an isolated paper model, order the root of trust, platform firmware, UEFI loader and OS kernel. Label verifier, verified data and failure handling at each handoff, separating firmware protection from UEFI image policy.
steps.observation: 沒有驗證的交接點，不能只因前一段可信就宣稱後一段可信。
steps.observationEn: An unverified handoff does not become trusted merely because its predecessor is trusted.
steps.failure: 把「已開啟 Secure Boot」視為所有裝置韌體都受保護，會漏掉範圍外元件。
steps.failureEn: Treating enabled Secure Boot as protection for every device firmware overlooks components outside its scope.
steps.check: 每條執行箭頭前都有對應驗證或明確列出的架構假設。
steps.checkEn: Precede every execution edge with verification or an explicitly recorded architectural assumption.

knowledge.title: 信任鏈
knowledge.text: 信任需要逐段建立，並以受保護的起點作基礎。
knowledge.textEn: Trust is established across successive stages from a protected starting point.

knowledge.title: 保護範圍
knowledge.text: UEFI 映像驗證與平台全部韌體的完整性是相關但不同的範圍。
knowledge.textEn: UEFI image verification and integrity of all platform firmware are related but distinct scopes.

quiz.question: 載入器可信，是否足以直接執行任何未驗證核心？
quiz.questionEn: Does a trusted loader justify executing any unverified kernel?
options: 不足，下一段仍需依其信任政策驗證。
足夠，前一段可信就等同所有後續輸入都受授權。
足夠，只要核心雜湊由該核心自己宣告即可。
optionsEn: No; the next stage still needs verification under its trust policy.
Yes; trust in the previous stage authorizes all subsequent inputs.
Yes; the kernel only needs to declare its own hash.
quiz.explanation: 不足，下一段仍需依其信任政策驗證。 信任需要逐段建立，並以受保護的起點作基礎。
quiz.explanationEn: No; the next stage still needs verification under its trust policy. Trust is established across successive stages from a protected starting point.

steps.title: 定義信任根與受保護狀態
steps.titleEn: Define roots of trust and protected state
steps.objective: 辨認不能由待驗證軟體自行改寫的信任依據。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify trust evidence that unverified software cannot rewrite at will.
steps.instruction: 在架構圖標出驗證程式、信任金鑰、版本狀態與復原根。對每項提出「誰能修改」及「修改如何授權」兩個問題，使用假設權限表而不操作真實韌體。
steps.instructionEn: Mark verifier code, trust keys, version state and recovery roots. For each, ask who can modify it and how changes are authorized, using a hypothetical permission table rather than modifying real firmware.
steps.observation: 若被驗證映像也能任意替換驗證金鑰，信任會形成循環。
steps.observationEn: If the image under review can freely replace its verification key, trust becomes circular.
steps.failure: 僅把金鑰檔案命名為 root 並不提供保護；需說明保護機制。
steps.failureEn: Naming a key file root provides no protection; explain the protection mechanism.
steps.check: 每個信任依據都有保護位置、修改權限與授權路徑。
steps.checkEn: Give each trust anchor a protected location, modification authority and authorization path.

knowledge.title: 信任起點
knowledge.text: 信任根的可靠性不能完全依賴它所驗證的軟體。
knowledge.textEn: A root’s reliability cannot depend entirely on the software it verifies.

knowledge.title: 受控更新
knowledge.text: 可更新的信任資料仍需要明確、受驗證的變更規則。
knowledge.textEn: Updatable trust data still need explicit authenticated change rules.

quiz.question: 若未驗證映像可以替換自己的信任金鑰，問題是什麼？
quiz.questionEn: What is wrong if an unverified image can replace its own trust key?
options: 只要更換後的金鑰格式正確，就不影響安全。
它可自行建立接受自己的依據，破壞信任邊界。
金鑰可修改代表系統自動具備安全更新能力。
optionsEn: A correctly formatted replacement key cannot affect security.
It can manufacture its own acceptance basis, breaking the trust boundary.
A modifiable key automatically provides secure update capability.
quiz.explanation: 它可自行建立接受自己的依據，破壞信任邊界。 信任根的可靠性不能完全依賴它所驗證的軟體。
quiz.explanationEn: It can manufacture its own acceptance basis, breaking the trust boundary. A root’s reliability cannot depend entirely on the software it verifies.

steps.title: 區分 PK、KEK、db 與 dbx
steps.titleEn: Separate PK, KEK, db and dbx
steps.objective: 把平台所有權、政策更新與映像允許權限分開。
steps.objectiveEn: Separate platform ownership, policy updates and image authorization.
steps.instruction: 建立四張權限卡，分別對應平台金鑰、金鑰交換金鑰、允許資料庫與禁止資料庫。用箭頭表示誰能授權更新哪個資料庫，另畫執行映像的判斷路徑。
steps.instructionEn: Create cards for PK, KEK, the allowed database and the forbidden database. Draw policy-update authorization arrows separately from the path used to decide whether an image executes.
steps.observation: 可以授權更新資料庫的金鑰，不等於自動允許所有由它簽署的執行映像。
steps.observationEn: A key authorized to update a database does not automatically authorize every executable it signs.
steps.failure: 把 PK 當成每個作業系統映像唯一簽署者，會混淆管理權與執行權。
steps.failureEn: Treating PK as the sole signer of every OS image confuses policy management with execution authorization.
steps.check: 能用一張圖區分金鑰管理與映像驗證兩條路徑。
steps.checkEn: Distinguish key-management and image-verification paths in one diagram.

knowledge.title: 權限分工
knowledge.text: UEFI 政策將平台控制、政策更新及映像信任資料分成不同角色。
knowledge.textEn: UEFI policy separates platform control, policy updates and image trust data into distinct roles.

knowledge.title: 最小授權
knowledge.text: 一種權限不能被推定為所有其他權限。
knowledge.textEn: One form of authority must not be assumed to grant every other authority.

quiz.question: KEK 的主要角色較接近哪個描述？
quiz.questionEn: Which description best matches the role of KEK?
options: 直接提供所有作業系統核心的執行允許清單。
記錄裝置目前韌體的量測雜湊。
授權相關安全啟動資料庫的更新。
optionsEn: Directly serving as the execution allow list for every OS kernel.
Recording measured hashes of the current device firmware.
Authorizing updates to the relevant Secure Boot databases.
quiz.explanation: 授權相關安全啟動資料庫的更新。 UEFI 政策將平台控制、政策更新及映像信任資料分成不同角色。
quiz.explanationEn: Authorizing updates to the relevant Secure Boot databases. UEFI policy separates platform control, policy updates and image trust data into distinct roles.

steps.title: 比較雜湊完整性與簽章授權
steps.titleEn: Compare hash integrity and signature authorization
steps.objective: 區分內容識別與可信發布者的判定。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish content identification from trusted-publisher authorization.
steps.instruction: 在紙上為原始映像與修改一位元的映像各指定不同雜湊，再加入可信與未知簽署者兩種卡片。分別判斷內容是否一致、簽章是否可驗證及簽署者是否受政策信任。
steps.instructionEn: Assign distinct hypothetical hashes to an original image and a one-bit modification, then add trusted and unknown signer cards. Separately judge content integrity, signature verification and policy trust in the signer.
steps.observation: 可算出雜湊，不代表該雜湊來自可信來源；簽章可驗證也仍需政策授權。
steps.observationEn: Computing a hash does not establish its trusted origin; a verifiable signature still needs policy authorization.
steps.failure: 從同一未知來源下載映像與雜湊，不能單靠兩者一致建立發布者信任。
steps.failureEn: An image and hash from the same unknown source do not establish publisher trust simply by matching.
steps.check: 每個接受結論同時說明內容驗證與信任來源。
steps.checkEn: Explain both integrity verification and trust provenance for each acceptance decision.

knowledge.title: 不同問題
knowledge.text: 雜湊描述內容，簽章與信任政策協助判斷授權來源。
knowledge.textEn: Hashes characterize content; signatures and trust policy help determine authorized origin.

knowledge.title: 私鑰保管
knowledge.text: 發布簽署私鑰不應隨待驗證映像交付給裝置作一般資料。
knowledge.textEn: A release-signing private key should not be distributed as ordinary data alongside the image it authenticates.

quiz.question: 映像和未知網站提供的雜湊一致，能證明什麼？
quiz.questionEn: An image matches a hash from an unknown website. What does that prove?
options: 兩者在內容識別上相符，仍未建立可信發布者。
已證明該網站是受授權的韌體發布者。
已證明此版本符合目前的撤銷與防回滾政策。
optionsEn: They agree as content identifiers, but a trusted publisher is not established.
It proves the website is an authorized firmware publisher.
It proves compliance with current revocation and rollback policies.
quiz.explanation: 兩者在內容識別上相符，仍未建立可信發布者。 雜湊描述內容，簽章與信任政策協助判斷授權來源。
quiz.explanationEn: They agree as content identifiers, but a trusted publisher is not established. Hashes characterize content; signatures and trust policy help determine authorized origin.

stages.title: 驗證與更新
stages.description: 推演允許、拒絕、模式與版本政策的不同效果。
stages.descriptionEn: Model allow/deny decisions, modes and version policies separately.

steps.title: 推演允許與撤銷的判斷順序
steps.objective: 理解明確撤銷不能被一般允許條目蓋過。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand why explicit revocation cannot be overridden by ordinary allowance.
steps.instruction: 建立三個基本案例：受信任且未撤銷、未知簽署者、映像雜湊明確列入 dbx。逐一走過驗證流程，在最後一例保留原本受信任的簽署者以檢查撤銷效果。
steps.instructionEn: Create basic cases for a trusted unrevoked image, an unknown signer and an image hash explicitly listed in dbx. Keep the last image’s signer otherwise trusted to test revocation independently.
steps.observation: 曾經可啟動的映像，在政策撤銷後可能需要被拒絕。
steps.observationEn: A previously bootable image may need rejection after policy revocation.
steps.failure: 把成功驗證簽章當成唯一通行證，會漏掉禁止資料庫的限制。
steps.failureEn: Treating signature verification as the only pass condition overlooks forbidden-database restrictions.
steps.check: 三個案例有清楚接受或拒絕結果，並標出所使用的政策版本。
steps.checkEn: Record a clear allow/deny outcome and policy revision for each case.

knowledge.title: 撤銷的用途
knowledge.text: 有效簽章不代表映像永遠適合被信任。
knowledge.textEn: A valid signature does not make an image suitable for trust forever.

knowledge.title: 政策版本
knowledge.text: 同一映像的判斷可因信任資料更新而改變。
knowledge.textEn: The decision on one image can change when trust data are updated.

quiz.question: 映像簽章有效，但其雜湊明確列入 dbx 的基本案例應如何處理？
quiz.questionEn: A signature is valid but the image hash is explicitly in dbx. What should this basic case do?
options: 忽略 dbx，因為簽章曾經有效。
依禁止政策拒絕該映像。
把 dbx 當作允許清單。
optionsEn: Ignore dbx because the signature was once valid.
Reject the image under the forbidden policy.
Treat dbx as an allow list.
quiz.explanation: 依禁止政策拒絕該映像。 有效簽章不代表映像永遠適合被信任。
quiz.explanationEn: Reject the image under the forbidden policy. A valid signature does not make an image suitable for trust forever.

steps.title: 區分設定模式與強制驗證狀態
steps.objective: 避免把政策已寫入誤當安全啟動已強制執行。
steps.objectiveEn: Avoid equating enrolled policy data with active enforcement.
steps.instruction: 使用假設狀態表記錄 SetupMode、SecureBoot 與已配置信任資料。比較初始佈建、正常強制驗證及維修例外三種情境；只作模型判讀，不變更本機設定。
steps.instructionEn: Use a hypothetical state table for SetupMode, SecureBoot and enrolled trust data. Compare provisioning, normal enforcement and a maintenance exception without changing this device’s settings.
steps.observation: 有金鑰資料與目前實際強制驗證，是需要分開確認的證據。
steps.observationEn: Presence of key data and current verification enforcement require separate confirmation.
steps.failure: 僅截取一張金鑰清單而不記錄執行狀態，可能錯認保護已生效。
steps.failureEn: A key-list screenshot without enforcement state can falsely imply protection is active.
steps.check: 能說明每個情境的權限和驗證狀態，例外有明確回復條件。
steps.checkEn: Explain authority and enforcement for each case, with explicit restoration conditions for exceptions.

knowledge.title: 狀態與資料
knowledge.text: 安全政策資料存在，不代表所有運作模式都相同。
knowledge.textEn: Security-policy data can exist while operating modes differ.

knowledge.title: 佈建邊界
knowledge.text: 初始化與部署後的變更規則需要明確區別。
knowledge.textEn: Initial provisioning and post-deployment change rules must be distinguished.

quiz.question: 看到 db 中有信任憑證，是否足以證明目前強制驗證已啟用？
quiz.questionEn: Does a trusted certificate in db prove enforcement is currently enabled?
options: 足夠，任何資料存在都會自動強制執行。
足夠，模式變數沒有用途。
不足，還需確認相關運作狀態。
optionsEn: Yes; any stored data automatically enforce themselves.
Yes; mode variables have no purpose.
No; the relevant operating state must also be confirmed.
quiz.explanation: 不足，還需確認相關運作狀態。 安全政策資料存在，不代表所有運作模式都相同。
quiz.explanationEn: No; the relevant operating state must also be confirmed. Security-policy data can exist while operating modes differ.

steps.title: 驗證先行與執行交接
steps.objective: 找出先執行後檢查的邏輯缺口。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the flaw in checking code after executing it.
steps.instruction: 將「讀入、驗證、政策判定、執行」排成狀態機，為失敗分支指定停止或可信復原。再故意交換驗證與執行的位置，說明這會讓哪個信任假設失效。
steps.instructionEn: Arrange read, verify, policy decision and execute into a state machine, with stop or trusted recovery on failure. Swap verification and execution deliberately and identify the broken trust assumption.
steps.observation: 記錄已執行程式的雜湊，不等於事先阻止未授權程式執行。
steps.observationEn: Recording a hash of executed code is not the same as preventing unauthorized execution beforehand.
steps.failure: 只有成功路徑而無失敗分支的流程圖，不能描述安全啟動的完整決策。
steps.failureEn: A success-only flowchart cannot describe the full secure-boot decision.
steps.check: 每個失敗狀態都不會直接跳到未驗證映像執行。
steps.checkEn: No failure state directly transfers control to an unverified image.

knowledge.title: 時間順序
knowledge.text: 驗證要保護執行交接，就必須在該交接前產生有效決定。
knowledge.textEn: Verification protects an execution handoff only when it establishes a valid decision before that handoff.

knowledge.title: 紀錄與阻擋
knowledge.text: 量測或稽核紀錄可補充證據，但不能假定等同阻擋機制。
knowledge.textEn: Measurement or audit records add evidence but must not be assumed equivalent to blocking.

quiz.question: 先執行映像、再驗證簽章的核心問題是什麼？
quiz.questionEn: What is the central flaw in executing an image before verifying its signature?
options: 未授權內容可能已取得執行機會。
只影響開機速度，不影響未授權內容的執行。
事後驗證失敗可自動撤回所有已發生的執行效果。
optionsEn: Unauthorized content may already have executed.
It affects boot speed but not unauthorized execution.
Failed post-execution verification automatically reverses all prior execution effects.
quiz.explanation: 未授權內容可能已取得執行機會。 驗證要保護執行交接，就必須在該交接前產生有效決定。
quiz.explanationEn: Unauthorized content may already have executed. Verification protects an execution handoff only when it establishes a valid decision before that handoff.

steps.title: 分開更新授權與防回滾政策
steps.titleEn: Separate update authorization from rollback policy
steps.objective: 理解舊的合法簽章仍可能對應不應再用的版本。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand that an old valid signature can identify an unsuitable version.
steps.instruction: 建立三個已簽署韌體版本的模型，其中一個已被產品政策淘汰。分別檢查簽署授權、映像完整性與版本下限，並註明防回滾是另外設計的機制。
steps.instructionEn: Model three signed firmware versions, one retired by product policy. Check signing authority, integrity and a minimum-version rule separately, explicitly treating rollback resistance as an additional mechanism.
steps.observation: 簽章是否有效與版本是否符合目前政策，可以得到不同答案。
steps.observationEn: Signature validity and current version-policy compliance can yield different answers.
steps.failure: 不能宣稱一般 UEFI Secure Boot 自動實作所有產品的版本計數器。
steps.failureEn: Do not claim generic UEFI Secure Boot automatically implements every product’s version counter.
steps.check: 更新表分別列出驗證、授權與版本決策，且描述例外復原的限制。
steps.checkEn: Separate verification, authorization and version decisions, including limits on recovery exceptions.

knowledge.title: 合法但過舊
knowledge.text: 映像曾由可信者發布，不代表今天仍應允許回復使用。
knowledge.textEn: A trusted past release is not necessarily acceptable to restore today.

knowledge.title: 版本狀態保護
knowledge.text: 若採用防回滾，最低版本等政策狀態也要受到保護。
knowledge.textEn: Rollback resistance also requires protection of policy state such as a minimum version.

quiz.question: 一個舊版簽章仍有效，最合理的下一步是什麼？
quiz.questionEn: An old version still has a valid signature. What is the reasonable next check?
options: 只檢查簽章數學上有效，就允許任何歷史版本。
確認目前版本與撤銷政策是否仍允許。
只比較版本字串長度，不檢查受保護的版本政策。
optionsEn: Permit every historical version if its signature is mathematically valid.
Check whether current version and revocation policies still permit it.
Compare version-string length rather than protected version policy.
quiz.explanation: 確認目前版本與撤銷政策是否仍允許。 映像曾由可信者發布，不代表今天仍應允許回復使用。
quiz.explanationEn: Check whether current version and revocation policies still permit it. A trusted past release is not necessarily acceptable to restore today.

stages.title: 復原與發布
stages.description: 以失敗案例與金鑰變更檢查系統是否仍可可信復原。
stages.descriptionEn: Use failures and key transitions to verify that trusted recovery remains possible.

steps.title: 設計金鑰輪替與撤銷順序
steps.titleEn: Plan key rotation and revocation order
steps.objective: 維持新舊發布與復原映像的相容過渡。
steps.objectiveEn: Maintain a compatible transition for releases and recovery images.
steps.instruction: 在時間線放置新增信任金鑰、更新啟動與復原映像、驗證部署結果及撤銷舊信任四件事。用離線或延遲更新裝置的案例，找出會使裝置無可信映像可啟動的排序。
steps.instructionEn: Place new trust enrollment, boot and recovery image updates, deployment verification and old-trust revocation on a timeline. Include delayed or offline devices to find sequences that leave no trusted bootable image.
steps.observation: 只更新日常啟動映像而忘記復原媒體，可能留下未來復原失效。
steps.observationEn: Updating the normal boot image but forgetting recovery media can create a later recovery failure.
steps.failure: 過早撤銷而沒有可用替代映像，不能靠重啟次數修正。
steps.failureEn: Premature revocation without a usable replacement cannot be repaired by repeated restarts.
steps.check: 輪替計畫涵蓋試點、延遲裝置、復原媒體及明確停止條件。
steps.checkEn: Cover pilot devices, delayed devices, recovery media and explicit stop criteria.

knowledge.title: 過渡相容性
knowledge.text: 金鑰政策與可啟動映像必須以相容順序更新。
knowledge.textEn: Key policy and bootable images must be updated in a compatible order.

knowledge.title: 簽署職責
knowledge.text: 發布、授權與私鑰保管職責應被明確分配。
knowledge.textEn: Release, authorization and private-key custody need explicit responsibility assignments.

quiz.question: 撤銷舊信任前，哪項檢查最直接避免無法啟動？
quiz.questionEn: Which check most directly avoids unbootable devices before old trust is revoked?
options: 只確認新金鑰已產生，不檢查裝置是否信任它。
只更新正常啟動映像，復原映像與輪替無關。
確認目標裝置與復原路徑已有受新政策接受的映像。
optionsEn: Confirm only that the new key exists, not whether devices trust it.
Update only normal boot images; recovery images are unrelated to rotation.
Confirm target devices and recovery paths have images accepted by the new policy.
quiz.explanation: 確認目標裝置與復原路徑已有受新政策接受的映像。 金鑰政策與可啟動映像必須以相容順序更新。
quiz.explanationEn: Confirm target devices and recovery paths have images accepted by the new policy. Key policy and bootable images must be updated in a compatible order.

steps.title: 建立可信復原而非任意回退
steps.titleEn: Design trusted recovery rather than arbitrary fallback
steps.objective: 確保恢復可用性不破壞完整性。
steps.objectiveEn: Restore availability without abandoning integrity.
steps.instruction: 在狀態圖加入主映像損壞、更新中斷與復原映像不受信任三種案例。為每種指定可驗證的復原來源和失敗出口，不把「任意舊檔」當成保證成功的備份。
steps.instructionEn: Add cases for a corrupt primary image, interrupted update and untrusted recovery image. Specify an authenticated recovery source and failure exit for each rather than treating any old file as a guaranteed backup.
steps.observation: 復原映像本身及其授權路徑也需要保護。
steps.observationEn: Recovery images and their authorization path also need protection.
steps.failure: 為了開機而跳過復原驗證，可能把故障處理變成信任繞過。
steps.failureEn: Skipping recovery verification merely to boot can turn fault handling into a trust bypass.
steps.check: 每條復原路徑都說明信任依據、版本政策與失敗時的處置。
steps.checkEn: State the trust basis, version policy and failure handling for every recovery path.

knowledge.title: 韌性三部分
knowledge.text: 韌體韌性結合保護、偵測與可信復原。
knowledge.textEn: Firmware resilience combines protection, detection and trusted recovery.

knowledge.title: 可用性與完整性
knowledge.text: 恢復運作仍須保持授權與完整性，兩者不是互斥選項。
knowledge.textEn: Restoring operation should preserve authorization and integrity rather than discard them.

quiz.question: 主映像損壞時，哪種復原做法符合信任設計？
quiz.questionEn: Which recovery approach preserves trust after the primary image is corrupted?
options: 驗證復原映像和其授權，再依政策恢復。
執行第一個找到的未知映像。
把所有簽章檢查永久關閉。
optionsEn: Verify the recovery image and authorization, then recover under policy.
Execute the first unknown image found.
Permanently disable every signature check.
quiz.explanation: 驗證復原映像和其授權，再依政策恢復。 韌體韌性結合保護、偵測與可信復原。
quiz.explanationEn: Verify the recovery image and authorization, then recover under policy. Firmware resilience combines protection, detection and trusted recovery.

steps.title: 建立拒絕案例與中斷案例矩陣
steps.titleEn: Build rejection and interruption test cases
steps.objective: 證明失敗路徑也符合設計意圖。
steps.objectiveEn: Show that failure paths also meet the design intent.
steps.instruction: 只在隔離模型列出內容遭修改、未知簽署者、明確撤銷、過舊版本及更新中斷五種案例。對每例預先寫下預期結果，再記錄模型的實際決策與差異。
steps.instructionEn: In an isolated model only, list modified content, an unknown signer, explicit revocation, an obsolete version and interrupted update. Write expected outcomes before recording modeled decisions and discrepancies.
steps.observation: 成功啟動一次不能替代拒絕未授權內容的測試。
steps.observationEn: One successful boot cannot replace tests that reject unauthorized content.
steps.failure: 測試後才改寫預期值以符合結果，會使驗證失去意義。
steps.failureEn: Rewriting expectations afterward to match outcomes makes verification meaningless.
steps.check: 矩陣含預期、觀察、政策版本與差異處置，且不接觸生產裝置。
steps.checkEn: Include expected outcome, observation, policy revision and discrepancy handling without touching production devices.

knowledge.title: 負向測試
knowledge.text: 安全功能需要證明應拒絕的輸入被正確拒絕。
knowledge.textEn: A security function must demonstrate correct rejection of inputs that should be denied.

knowledge.title: 事先判據
knowledge.text: 先寫預期結果，才能辨認實作與設計的差異。
knowledge.textEn: Defining expected outcomes first makes implementation discrepancies visible.

quiz.question: 所有合法映像都能啟動，是否代表拒絕機制已驗證？
quiz.questionEn: All legitimate images boot. Does that verify the rejection mechanism?
options: 有，允許清單運作就能推定禁止清單正確。
沒有，仍須測試應拒絕的案例。
有，因為沒有發現啟動失敗就代表所有拒絕路徑正確。
optionsEn: Yes; a working allow list proves the deny list works.
No; cases that should be rejected still need testing.
Yes; no observed boot failures proves every rejection path correct.
quiz.explanation: 沒有，仍須測試應拒絕的案例。 安全功能需要證明應拒絕的輸入被正確拒絕。
quiz.explanationEn: No; cases that should be rejected still need testing. A security function must demonstrate correct rejection of inputs that should be denied.

steps.title: 交付發布清單與可稽核證據
steps.titleEn: Deliver release inventory and auditable evidence
steps.objective: 讓裝置狀態、信任政策與復原能力可追溯。
steps.objectiveEn: Make device state, trust policy and recovery capability traceable.
steps.instruction: 整理元件清單、信任角色、版本政策、測試矩陣與復原演練結果。為小批試點和大批部署各設一個停止條件，說明收到異常結果時如何保留證據與暫停推進。
steps.instructionEn: Assemble component inventory, trust roles, version policy, test matrix and recovery-exercise results. Define a stop criterion for pilot and wider rollout, preserving evidence and pausing progression on anomalies.
steps.observation: 文件應能回答哪台裝置、哪版政策、哪個映像與哪次驗證，而不只寫「安全」。
steps.observationEn: Records should identify device, policy revision, image and verification event rather than simply say secure.
steps.failure: 分享稽核資料時不應把簽署私鑰混入交付附件。
steps.failureEn: Audit deliverables must not accidentally include signing private keys.
steps.check: 交付包包含可讀證據與限制，沒有宣稱模型測試等同整個平台安全認證。
steps.checkEn: Deliver readable evidence and limitations without equating model tests with complete platform certification.

knowledge.title: 可追溯發布
knowledge.text: 發布決定需要連接映像身分、授權與實際驗證結果。
knowledge.textEn: Release decisions should connect image identity, authorization and observed verification results.

knowledge.title: 範圍誠實
knowledge.text: 啟動信任是系統防護的一部分，不涵蓋所有執行期漏洞。
knowledge.textEn: Boot trust is one part of system protection and does not cover every runtime vulnerability.

quiz.question: 哪份紀錄最能支持可信交付？
quiz.questionEn: Which record best supports a trustworthy handoff?
options: 只有一張成功開機畫面，未記錄政策與映像版本。
只有映像雜湊清單，未連接裝置、授權與復原測試。
裝置、映像、政策版本、測試結果與復原限制的對應表。
optionsEn: Only a successful-boot screenshot with no policy or image revision.
Only image hashes without links to devices, authorization or recovery tests.
A mapping of devices, images, policy revisions, test results and recovery limitations.
quiz.explanation: 裝置、映像、政策版本、測試結果與復原限制的對應表。 發布決定需要連接映像身分、授權與實際驗證結果。
quiz.explanationEn: A mapping of devices, images, policy revisions, test results and recovery limitations. Release decisions should connect image identity, authorization and observed verification results.

existing.scope: 公開原理的十二項教學任務，以自行繪製的示意模型、試算及來源資料進行；未提供工廠實測資料、專有配方或設備操作許可。 僅使用隔離的架構與狀態模型；不變更使用者裝置的金鑰、韌體或安全啟動設定。
existing.scopeEn: Twelve educational tasks based on public principles, using original schematic models, calculations and referenced material. No factory measurement dataset, proprietary recipe or equipment operating authorization is supplied. Uses isolated architecture and state models only; does not change device keys, firmware or Secure Boot settings.

existing.title: 分散式共識服務
existing.summary: 用紙上訊息回放建立 Raft 的多數、選舉與提交，再延伸到線性化讀取、重試、成員變更、效能及快照復原。
existing.summaryEn: Use message replays to develop Raft quorums, election and commitment, then study linearizable reads, retries, membership changes, performance and snapshot recovery.
existing.scope: 依公開原理編寫的四階段、24 個教學工作包；每步需交出模型、判讀或驗證紀錄。數值練習為自訂教學案例，不是廠商製程配方、現場操作許可或專業設計認證。 etcd 例子固定參考 v3.5 文件以便重現概念，並非目前最新版的安裝操作手冊。
existing.scopeEn: Four stages and 24 educational work packages based on public principles. Each step produces a model, interpretation or verification record. Numerical exercises are hypothetical, not manufacturer recipes, field operating authorization or professional design certification. The etcd examples pin v3.5 documentation for reproducible concepts; this is not an installation manual for the latest release.

stages.title: 故障模型與複製狀態
stages.description: 界定當機、延遲、狀態機與多數的保證範圍。
stages.descriptionEn: Define crashes, delays, state machines and majority guarantees.

steps.title: 界定共識服務的保證
steps.objective: 把一致決策與一般資料複製分開。
steps.objectiveEn: Separate agreed decisions from ordinary copying.
steps.instruction: 選一個配置鍵值服務；列出讀寫需求；畫三個副本；寫下同一日誌位置不可執行不同命令的不變量。
steps.instructionEn: Choose a configuration key-value service; list read/write needs; draw three replicas; state that one log position must not apply conflicting commands.
steps.observation: 副本內容暫時不同不必然代表已提交狀態衝突。
steps.observationEn: Temporary replica differences need not imply conflicting committed state.
steps.failure: 不要以「有三份」直接宣告一致性，補上提交規則。
steps.failureEn: Do not infer consistency from three copies; add commitment rules.
steps.check: 服務契約有資料模型及可檢查不變量。
steps.checkEn: The contract has a data model and testable invariant.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 共識協調決策順序，複製只是必要機制之一。
knowledge.textEn: Consensus coordinates decision order; replication is one mechanism.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 安全性與能否持續服務是不同問題。
knowledge.textEn: Safety and continued availability are different questions.

quiz.question: 三份資料是否自動構成共識？
quiz.questionEn: Do three copies automatically provide consensus?
options: 否，仍需決策與提交規則。
是，複製數量決定所有語義。
是，三台永遠不會失效。
optionsEn: No; decision and commitment rules are still needed.
Yes; copy count determines all semantics.
Yes; three machines cannot fail.
quiz.explanation: 否，仍需決策與提交規則。 共識協調決策順序，複製只是必要機制之一。
quiz.explanationEn: No; decision and commitment rules are still needed. Consensus coordinates decision order; replication is one mechanism.

steps.title: 建立當機與網路延遲模型
steps.objective: 明確 Raft 不處理的惡意行為。
steps.objectiveEn: State malicious behavior outside Raft's basic model.
steps.instruction: 畫正常、停機及慢訊息三情境；標出丟失、重排及重複訊息；另列任意偽造訊息的情境；將它標為不同信任模型。
steps.instructionEn: Draw normal, crashed and delayed-message cases; mark loss, reordering and duplication; list arbitrary forged messages separately; identify the different trust model.
steps.observation: 無法立即分辨停機與網路很慢。
steps.observationEn: A crash cannot always be immediately distinguished from a slow network.
steps.failure: 不把一般 Raft 描述為拜占庭容錯。
steps.failureEn: Do not describe ordinary Raft as Byzantine fault tolerant.
steps.check: 故障表明確列出涵蓋與不涵蓋項。
steps.checkEn: The failure table states covered and excluded cases.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: Raft 的基本保證建立在非拜占庭故障假設上。
knowledge.textEn: Basic Raft guarantees assume non-Byzantine failures.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 逾時是懷疑訊號，不是停機的絕對證明。
knowledge.textEn: Timeout is suspicion, not proof of a crash.

quiz.question: 訊息逾時能證明遠端永久停機嗎？
quiz.questionEn: Does timeout prove permanent remote failure?
options: 能，網路沒有排隊。
不能，也可能是延遲或分割。
能，因此可忽略任期。
optionsEn: Yes; networks never queue.
No; delay or partition is also possible.
Yes; terms can therefore be ignored.
quiz.explanation: 不能，也可能是延遲或分割。 Raft 的基本保證建立在非拜占庭故障假設上。
quiz.explanationEn: No; delay or partition is also possible. Basic Raft guarantees assume non-Byzantine failures.

steps.title: 建立確定性的狀態機
steps.objective: 確保相同命令序列產生相同結果。
steps.objectiveEn: Ensure equal command sequences produce equal results.
steps.instruction: 定義 set 與 increment 命令；讓三副本由同一初始值開始；依同順序回放；再加入本地時間作輸入並找出分歧。
steps.instructionEn: Define set and increment commands; start three replicas identically; replay in the same order; add local time as an input and locate divergence.
steps.observation: 外部時間或隨機數未記錄時會造成不一致。
steps.observationEn: Unrecorded time or randomness can cause divergence.
steps.failure: 將非確定值先寫入命令資料，不在各副本臨時生成。
steps.failureEn: Record nondeterministic values in command data rather than generating them per replica.
steps.check: 三份狀態與每一步命令可重放對照。
steps.checkEn: All three states and each command can be replayed.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 複製狀態機依賴確定的應用結果。
knowledge.textEn: Replicated state machines rely on deterministic application.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 一致的日誌無法補救不確定的應用邏輯。
knowledge.textEn: An agreed log cannot fix nondeterministic application logic.

quiz.question: 相同日誌但各自讀取當下時間有何風險？
quiz.questionEn: What if replicas read local time despite sharing a log?
options: 必然更一致。
可省略命令順序。
狀態結果可能不同。
optionsEn: Consistency necessarily improves.
Command order becomes unnecessary.
State results may diverge.
quiz.explanation: 狀態結果可能不同。 複製狀態機依賴確定的應用結果。
quiz.explanationEn: State results may diverge. Replicated state machines rely on deterministic application.

steps.title: 計算三台與五台的多數
steps.titleEn: Compute majorities for three and five nodes
steps.objective: 以集合交集理解容錯。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand fault tolerance through quorum intersection.
steps.instruction: 列出三台的所有兩台集合；比較任兩集合交集；再算五台的三票多數；移除不同數量節點檢查能否形成多數。
steps.instructionEn: List all two-member sets from three nodes; compare intersections; calculate three-vote majorities for five; remove nodes and check quorum availability.
steps.observation: 多數交集支持已決定資訊跨任期保存。
steps.observationEn: Majority intersection helps retain decided information across terms.
steps.failure: 不要把「活著的節點過半」取代既定投票成員多數。
steps.failureEn: Do not redefine quorum as a majority of currently reachable members.
steps.check: 表格正確顯示三台需二票、五台需三票。
steps.checkEn: Show that three members need two votes and five need three.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 多數是相對於叢集的投票成員配置。
knowledge.textEn: A majority is defined by the voting membership configuration.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 失去多數時可停止進展以保持安全性。
knowledge.textEn: Without a majority, progress can stop to preserve safety.

quiz.question: 五投票成員只剩兩台可通訊，能提交新寫入嗎？
quiz.questionEn: Can two reachable members of five commit a new write?
options: 不能，未達三票多數。
能，因為兩台互相同意。
能，將失聯者自動刪除即可。
optionsEn: No; three votes are required.
Yes; they agree with each other.
Yes; automatically delete unreachable members.
quiz.explanation: 不能，未達三票多數。 多數是相對於叢集的投票成員配置。
quiz.explanationEn: No; three votes are required. A majority is defined by the voting membership configuration.

steps.title: 區分記錄、提交與套用
steps.objective: 避免以本地寫入冒充服務完成。
steps.objectiveEn: Avoid treating local append as completed service.
steps.instruction: 畫客戶端到領導者再到跟隨者的時序；標本地保存、符合提交條件及套用三點；放入一個只到領導者的命令；判斷可否回覆成功。
steps.instructionEn: Draw client-to-leader-to-follower timing; mark local persistence, valid commitment and application; add a leader-only entry; decide whether success is justified.
steps.observation: 日誌存在於某台不等於已提交。
steps.observationEn: An entry on one node is not necessarily committed.
steps.failure: 若直接以收到請求回成功，回到服務契約檢查耐久語義。
steps.failureEn: Check durability semantics if success is returned on receipt alone.
steps.check: 時序圖三狀態清楚且回覆位置有理由。
steps.checkEn: Distinguish all three states and justify response timing.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 提交與套用是不同邊界。
knowledge.textEn: Commitment and application are distinct boundaries.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 成功回覆必須符合對外 API 承諾。
knowledge.textEn: Success responses must satisfy the external API contract.

quiz.question: 領導者已寫入本地就必定已提交嗎？
quiz.questionEn: Does local leader persistence necessarily imply commitment?
options: 一定，本地磁碟就是多數。
不一定，還需協定提交條件。
一定，客戶端已送出就算完成。
optionsEn: Yes; one disk is a majority.
No; protocol commitment conditions still apply.
Yes; sending means completion.
quiz.explanation: 不一定，還需協定提交條件。 提交與套用是不同邊界。
quiz.explanationEn: No; protocol commitment conditions still apply. Commitment and application are distinct boundaries.

steps.title: 建立節點持久狀態帳本
steps.objective: 理解重啟後需保留的協定資訊。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify protocol information that must survive restart.
steps.instruction: 為節點畫 currentTerm、votedFor 與 log 三欄；模擬投票後重啟；比較保留與遺失投票資訊；指出哪種情況可能重複投票。
steps.instructionEn: Track currentTerm, votedFor and log; simulate restart after voting; compare retained and lost vote state; identify potential double voting.
steps.observation: 應答前保存的順序會影響正確性。
steps.observationEn: Persistence-before-response order affects correctness.
steps.failure: 不要只備份鍵值資料卻忽略協定狀態語義。
steps.failureEn: Do not equate key-value backup with all protocol-state semantics.
steps.check: 帳本標出何時保存、何時回覆及重啟讀回。
steps.checkEn: Mark persistence, response and restart recovery points.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: Raft 的任期、投票與日誌含必要持久狀態。
knowledge.textEn: Raft terms, votes and logs include necessary persistent state.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 磁碟寫入成功的定義須符合系統耐久假設。
knowledge.textEn: A successful write must meet the durability assumptions.

quiz.question: 投票記錄遺失後重啟可能造成什麼？
quiz.questionEn: What can losing vote state across restart cause?
options: 自動提高共識可靠度。
使多數要求永久降低。
同任期不當重複投票的風險。
optionsEn: Automatically stronger consensus.
A permanently smaller quorum.
Risk of an improper second vote in the same term.
quiz.explanation: 同任期不當重複投票的風險。 Raft 的任期、投票與日誌含必要持久狀態。
quiz.explanationEn: Risk of an improper second vote in the same term. Raft terms, votes and logs include necessary persistent state.

stages.title: 選舉、日誌與提交
stages.description: 依任期與日誌規則逐一回放訊息。
stages.descriptionEn: Replay messages against term and log rules.

steps.title: 回放任期與領導者選舉
steps.objective: 按任期區分過期訊息。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish stale messages by term.
steps.instruction: 畫三節點的 follower、candidate、leader 狀態；觸發一個教學逾時；逐張傳送票卡；加入舊任期訊息並標出應拒絕處。
steps.instructionEn: Draw follower, candidate and leader states for three nodes; trigger a teaching timeout; deliver vote cards individually; add an old-term message and mark rejection.
steps.observation: 新任期訊息會改變節點對領導權的認知。
steps.observationEn: Newer terms change a node's view of leadership.
steps.failure: 不以機器名稱或實體時間決定任期較新。
steps.failureEn: Do not decide term order from machine names or wall clocks.
steps.check: 每一步記錄任期、角色與投票。
steps.checkEn: Record term, role and vote at every step.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 任期是協定的邏輯次序。
knowledge.textEn: Terms provide protocol logical ordering.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 角色轉換需依訊息與協定條件。
knowledge.textEn: Role transitions follow messages and protocol conditions.

quiz.question: 舊任期領導者的訊息可覆蓋新任期嗎？
quiz.questionEn: Can an old leader overwrite a newer term?
options: 不能，應按任期規則處理。
可以，只要名稱排序較前。
可以，只要傳送速度較快。
optionsEn: No; apply the term rules.
Yes, if its name sorts earlier.
Yes, if it sends faster.
quiz.explanation: 不能，應按任期規則處理。 任期是協定的邏輯次序。
quiz.explanationEn: No; apply the term rules. Terms provide protocol logical ordering.

steps.title: 檢查候選者日誌新舊
steps.objective: 避免遺漏已決定的歷史。
steps.objectiveEn: Avoid electing a candidate that loses decided history.
steps.instruction: 給三節點不同最後任期與索引；先比較最後任期；相同時再比較索引；為每個投票決定寫理由。
steps.instructionEn: Assign different last-log terms and indexes; compare last terms first; use indexes when terms tie; justify each vote.
steps.observation: 日誌比較不是只數項目最多。
steps.observationEn: Log freshness is not simply the largest entry count.
steps.failure: 若只按索引投票，重新比較最後項的任期。
steps.failureEn: Compare final-entry terms before an index-only vote.
steps.check: 所有投票都能依相同排序規則重現。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce each vote with the same ordering rule.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: Raft 選舉限制候選者日誌的足夠新鮮度。
knowledge.textEn: Raft restricts candidate log freshness.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 任期優先於最後索引的比較可避免錯誤直覺。
knowledge.textEn: Term-before-index ordering prevents misleading length-only intuition.

quiz.question: 最後索引較大一定比較新嗎？
quiz.questionEn: Is a larger final index always more up to date?
options: 是，日誌只看長度。
否，還須先比較最後任期。
是，任期只供顯示。
optionsEn: Yes; only length matters.
No; compare the final term first.
Yes; terms are decorative.
quiz.explanation: 否，還須先比較最後任期。 Raft 選舉限制候選者日誌的足夠新鮮度。
quiz.explanationEn: No; compare the final term first. Raft restricts candidate log freshness.

steps.title: 驗證日誌前綴匹配
steps.objective: 用索引與任期定位衝突。
steps.objectiveEn: Locate conflicts with index and term.
steps.instruction: 畫領導者與跟隨者日誌；為一次 AppendEntries 填前項索引與任期；製造一個不匹配；回退到共同前綴再推演更新。
steps.instructionEn: Draw leader and follower logs; fill previous index and term for AppendEntries; introduce a mismatch; return to the common prefix and replay the update.
steps.observation: 相同索引可以在未提交部分含不同內容。
steps.observationEn: The same index can differ in uncommitted suffixes.
steps.failure: 不要合併兩份衝突命令為同一位置。
steps.failureEn: Do not merge conflicting commands into one position.
steps.check: 回放保留共同前綴並解釋衝突處理。
steps.checkEn: Preserve the common prefix and explain conflict handling.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: Raft 用前項匹配檢查日誌連續性。
knowledge.textEn: Raft checks continuity using preceding-entry matching.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 未提交尾端與已提交歷史有不同處理限制。
knowledge.textEn: Uncommitted suffixes and committed history have different constraints.

quiz.question: 索引相同就能直接接受新項嗎？
quiz.questionEn: Does a matching index alone justify acceptance?
options: 可以，任期永不變。
可以，命令內容不重要。
不能，還需匹配任期等條件。
optionsEn: Yes; terms never change.
Yes; command content is irrelevant.
No; matching term and other conditions matter.
quiz.explanation: 不能，還需匹配任期等條件。 Raft 用前項匹配檢查日誌連續性。
quiz.explanationEn: No; matching term and other conditions matter. Raft checks continuity using preceding-entry matching.

steps.title: 辨認當前任期提交規則
steps.objective: 避免只按任意多數副本計算提交。
steps.objectiveEn: Avoid committing arbitrary old entries by replica count alone.
steps.instruction: 建立含舊任期項的三節點日誌；標出新領導者任期；比較只複製舊項與提交一個當前任期項；追蹤被涵蓋的前綴。
steps.instructionEn: Build three logs containing an older-term entry; mark the new leader's term; compare copying that old entry with committing a current-term entry; track the implied prefix.
steps.observation: 舊項已在多數出現不等於可直接套用同一計數規則。
steps.observationEn: An old entry appearing on a majority does not permit the same direct counting rule.
steps.failure: 務必依原論文限制，不把所有多數副本都標成已提交。
steps.failureEn: Follow the paper's restriction; do not mark every majority-held entry committed.
steps.check: 回放清楚分辨直接提交及隨前綴成為已提交。
steps.checkEn: Distinguish direct commitment from commitment through the prefix.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: Raft 領導者以副本數推進提交時需檢查當前任期。
knowledge.textEn: A Raft leader advancing commitment by counting replicas checks the current term.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 正確提交新任期項可同時確立前序項。
knowledge.textEn: Committing a current-term entry also establishes prior entries.

quiz.question: 舊任期項只要多數持有就能直接按相同規則提交嗎？
quiz.questionEn: Can an older-term entry always be directly committed by the same majority rule?
options: 不能，需遵守當前任期限制。
能，任期與安全性無關。
能，只要磁碟容量足夠。
optionsEn: No; the current-term restriction matters.
Yes; term is unrelated to safety.
Yes, if disk space is sufficient.
quiz.explanation: 不能，需遵守當前任期限制。 Raft 領導者以副本數推進提交時需檢查當前任期。
quiz.explanationEn: No; the current-term restriction matters. A Raft leader advancing commitment by counting replicas checks the current term.

steps.title: 回放網路分割與舊領導者
steps.titleEn: Replay a partition and a stale leader
steps.objective: 理解一致性與可用性的分離。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand the separation of safety and availability.
steps.instruction: 把五節點分成三與二；將舊領導者放少數側；在兩側各送一請求；記錄誰能形成多數，恢復連線後再比較日誌。
steps.instructionEn: Partition five nodes into three and two; place the old leader in the minority; submit a request on each side; track quorum formation and reconcile after healing.
steps.observation: 自認領導者不等於有能力提交。
steps.observationEn: Believing oneself leader does not imply commitment ability.
steps.failure: 不讓少數側自行改小成員數以繞過多數。
steps.failureEn: Do not let the minority shrink membership to bypass quorum.
steps.check: 兩側提交結果與恢復後狀態不違反不變量。
steps.checkEn: Commit results and post-healing state preserve the invariant.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 少數分區無法取得原配置多數。
knowledge.textEn: A minority partition cannot obtain the original configuration's quorum.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 暫時停止寫入可防止互相衝突的決定。
knowledge.textEn: Temporarily stopping writes can prevent conflicting decisions.

quiz.question: 少數側舊領導者可只靠自己承諾新寫入嗎？
quiz.questionEn: Can an isolated minority leader commit alone?
options: 可以，領導者權限無限制。
不能，仍需多數。
可以，將逾時視為同意。
optionsEn: Yes; leadership is unlimited.
No; a majority is still required.
Yes; interpret timeout as approval.
quiz.explanation: 不能，仍需多數。 少數分區無法取得原配置多數。
quiz.explanationEn: No; a majority is still required. A minority partition cannot obtain the original configuration's quorum.

steps.title: 設計重複與亂序訊息測試
steps.objective: 檢查協定是否依內容而非到達次序。
steps.objectiveEn: Check protocol decisions beyond arrival order.
steps.instruction: 複製一張舊回覆卡；將兩張訊息交換順序；重播同一批訊息；檢查任期、索引與已提交狀態是否保持一致。
steps.instructionEn: Duplicate an old reply; swap two messages; replay the batch; check terms, indexes and committed state for consistency.
steps.observation: 最晚到達的訊息不一定最新。
steps.observationEn: The last message to arrive need not be newest.
steps.failure: 若以到達時間覆寫狀態，補上任期及索引比較。
steps.failureEn: Add term and index checks if arrival order overwrites state.
steps.check: 測試紀錄包含原順序與擾動順序的結果。
steps.checkEn: Record outcomes for original and perturbed schedules.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 網路重複及重排是協定需面對的情境。
knowledge.textEn: Duplicates and reordering are protocol concerns.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 不變量應在每一步成立，而非只看最終畫面。
knowledge.textEn: Invariants should hold at each step, not only in the final display.

quiz.question: 最後到的回覆一定代表最新狀態嗎？
quiz.questionEn: Does the latest arrival always represent the newest state?
options: 是，傳輸時間等於邏輯時間。
是，只要資料包較大。
否，要檢查任期與索引。
optionsEn: Yes; transit order equals logical time.
Yes, if the packet is larger.
No; check term and index.
quiz.explanation: 否，要檢查任期與索引。 網路重複及重排是協定需面對的情境。
quiz.explanationEn: No; check term and index. Duplicates and reordering are protocol concerns.

stages.title: 讀寫語義與成員維護
stages.description: 檢查 API、重試、watch 與成員變更的邊界。
stages.descriptionEn: Check API, retries, watches and membership boundaries.

steps.title: 比較線性化與可陳舊讀取
steps.titleEn: Compare linearizable and potentially stale reads
steps.objective: 依應用契約選擇讀取語義。
steps.objectiveEn: Choose read semantics from the application contract.
steps.instruction: 畫寫入成功後再讀取的時間線；讓一個跟隨者落後；比較需確認最新狀態與容許舊值的讀取；為配置與統計快取各選語義。
steps.instructionEn: Draw a completed write followed by a read; lag one follower; compare freshness-checked and stale-permitted reads; choose semantics for configuration and statistical caches.
steps.observation: 較低延遲讀取可能付出新鮮度代價。
steps.observationEn: Lower-latency reads may trade away freshness.
steps.failure: 不將 watch 或任意本地讀取直接標為線性化。
steps.failureEn: Do not label watches or arbitrary local reads linearizable.
steps.check: 時間線能說明哪些舊值違反所選契約。
steps.checkEn: The timeline identifies stale values violating the selected contract.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 線性化與實際時間先後有關。
knowledge.textEn: Linearizability constrains real-time ordering.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: etcd 的 serializable 讀取選項可能回傳相對多數較舊的值。
knowledge.textEn: etcd's serializable read option may return data stale relative to quorum.

quiz.question: 完成寫入後的強一致讀取可任意讀落後副本嗎？
quiz.questionEn: Can a strong read after completed write use an arbitrary lagging replica?
options: 不能，需滿足新鮮度保證。
可以，所有副本永遠同步。
可以，只要有 TLS。
optionsEn: No; freshness guarantees must hold.
Yes; all replicas are always synchronized.
Yes, provided TLS is used.
quiz.explanation: 不能，需滿足新鮮度保證。 線性化與實際時間先後有關。
quiz.explanationEn: No; freshness guarantees must hold. Linearizability constrains real-time ordering.

steps.title: 處理逾時與重試的不確定性
steps.objective: 避免把未知結果當失敗後重做。
steps.objectiveEn: Avoid treating unknown outcome as definite failure.
steps.instruction: 模擬寫入已提交但回覆遺失；讓客戶端重試 increment；比較有無請求識別碼；設計重複請求的結果查詢紀錄。
steps.instructionEn: Commit a write but lose its response; retry an increment; compare with and without request IDs; design result lookup for duplicates.
steps.observation: 客戶端逾時時操作可能已成功。
steps.observationEn: An operation may have succeeded despite client timeout.
steps.failure: 不宣稱共識自動提供所有應用的恰好一次語義。
steps.failureEn: Do not claim consensus automatically gives every application exactly-once semantics.
steps.check: 案例能避免無意重複業務效果。
steps.checkEn: The design prevents unintended duplicate business effects.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 傳输不確定性與提交狀態是不同問題。
knowledge.textEn: Transport uncertainty and commitment are separate issues.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 應用需明確設計冪等或重複偵測。
knowledge.textEn: Applications need explicit idempotency or deduplication.

quiz.question: 收到逾時能否確定操作未發生？
quiz.questionEn: Does timeout prove the operation did not happen?
options: 能，所以立即重做一定安全。
不能，結果可能未知。
能，伺服器必定已回滾。
optionsEn: Yes; immediate repetition is always safe.
No; the outcome may be unknown.
Yes; the server must have rolled back.
quiz.explanation: 不能，結果可能未知。 傳输不確定性與提交狀態是不同問題。
quiz.explanationEn: No; the outcome may be unknown. Transport uncertainty and commitment are separate issues.

steps.title: 用比較交換保護更新
steps.objective: 防止讀後寫覆蓋他人修改。
steps.objectiveEn: Prevent read-modify-write from overwriting another update.
steps.instruction: 讓兩客戶端讀相同版本；各提出不同修改；先執行無條件更新；再以版本條件重演並記錄拒絕的一方。
steps.instructionEn: Let two clients read the same version; propose different edits; perform unconditional writes; replay with a version condition and record the rejected update.
steps.observation: 共識可排序寫入，但無條件覆蓋仍可能違反業務意圖。
steps.observationEn: Consensus orders writes, but unconditional overwrites can still violate intent.
steps.failure: 不要把伺服器一致性當成自動解決所有應用競爭。
steps.failureEn: Do not equate server consistency with automatic resolution of all application races.
steps.check: 回放顯示衝突被顯式識別而非悄悄遺失。
steps.checkEn: The replay exposes conflicts instead of silently losing updates.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 條件交易將預期版本納入寫入判斷。
knowledge.textEn: Conditional transactions include the expected version in the write decision.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 業務不變量需由應用和儲存語義共同維持。
knowledge.textEn: Business invariants need application logic and storage semantics together.

quiz.question: 為何一致資料庫仍可能遺失使用者修改？
quiz.questionEn: Why can a consistent store still lose a user's intended edit?
options: 因為共識完全沒有順序。
因為版本檢查一定無效。
無條件覆寫可按順序覆蓋先前修改。
optionsEn: Because consensus has no ordering.
Because version checks never work.
Ordered unconditional writes can overwrite earlier edits.
quiz.explanation: 無條件覆寫可按順序覆蓋先前修改。 條件交易將預期版本納入寫入判斷。
quiz.explanationEn: Ordered unconditional writes can overwrite earlier edits. Conditional transactions include the expected version in the write decision.

steps.title: 規劃 watch 中斷與歷史壓縮
steps.objective: 處理事件歷史已不再保留的情況。
steps.objectiveEn: Handle event history that is no longer retained.
steps.instruction: 畫 revision 逐次增加的事件列；中斷一個觀察者；壓縮部分舊歷史；分別推演可續看與需重新取得快照的情境。
steps.instructionEn: Draw increasing revisions; disconnect a watcher; compact older history; replay cases that can resume and those needing a fresh snapshot.
steps.observation: 快取必須知道自己最後確認的 revision。
steps.observationEn: A cache needs its last confirmed revision.
steps.failure: 不把壓縮後不存在的歷史當成空事件。
steps.failureEn: Do not interpret unavailable compacted history as no events.
steps.check: 重連流程明確區分續看與重建快取。
steps.checkEn: The reconnection plan distinguishes resume from cache rebuild.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: watch 的可恢復性受到保留歷史範圍限制。
knowledge.textEn: Watch resumption is limited by retained history.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: watch 本身不等同線性化讀取保證。
knowledge.textEn: A watch is not itself a linearizable-read guarantee.

quiz.question: 需要的 revision 已被壓縮時應如何處理？
quiz.questionEn: What if the required revision has been compacted?
options: 重新同步狀態並建立新的觀察起點。
假裝中間沒有任何變更。
只把本地 revision 任意加一。
optionsEn: Resynchronize state and establish a new watch point.
Assume no intervening changes.
Increment the local revision arbitrarily.
quiz.explanation: 重新同步狀態並建立新的觀察起點。 watch 的可恢復性受到保留歷史範圍限制。
quiz.explanationEn: Resynchronize state and establish a new watch point. Watch resumption is limited by retained history.

steps.title: 以 learner 規劃擴容
steps.objective: 避免追趕新節點時提前改變多數條件。
steps.objectiveEn: Avoid changing quorum before a new node catches up.
steps.instruction: 畫三投票成員及一非投票 learner；追蹤 learner 的落後索引；比較直接增加投票者的情境；列出提升前需驗證的狀態。
steps.instructionEn: Draw three voters and one nonvoting learner; track the learner's lag; compare immediately adding a voter; list checks before promotion.
steps.observation: 非投票複製者可先追趕而不增加當前多數門檻。
steps.observationEn: A nonvoter can catch up without increasing the current quorum threshold.
steps.failure: 不讓 learner 自動被當成已可投票成員。
steps.failureEn: Do not silently count a learner as a voter.
steps.check: 配置表在每階段列出投票者及多數數目。
steps.checkEn: List voters and quorum size at every stage.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 成員變更會影響協定的多數定義。
knowledge.textEn: Membership changes affect quorum definitions.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: etcd learner 需追上後經受控提升。
knowledge.textEn: An etcd learner catches up before controlled promotion.

quiz.question: learner 剛加入時是否計入投票多數？
quiz.questionEn: Does a newly added learner count toward voting quorum?
options: 計入，只要網路接通。
不計入，直到正式提升。
計入，只要有磁碟。
optionsEn: Yes, once connected.
No, until promoted.
Yes, once it has a disk.
quiz.explanation: 不計入，直到正式提升。 成員變更會影響協定的多數定義。
quiz.explanationEn: No, until promoted. Membership changes affect quorum definitions.

steps.title: 比較機器故障與共同故障域
steps.titleEn: Compare machine failures and shared failure domains
steps.objective: 避免把節點數誤當獨立性。
steps.objectiveEn: Avoid equating node count with independence.
steps.instruction: 把五節點分配到三個機房；列供電與網路共用項；模擬失去一個機房；重新算剩餘多數，另比較跨區延遲。
steps.instructionEn: Place five nodes across three sites; list shared power and network dependencies; lose one site; recalculate quorum and compare intersite latency.
steps.observation: 節點分散可以減少共同失效，但增加通訊成本。
steps.observationEn: Distribution can reduce shared failure but add communication cost.
steps.failure: 不只看伺服器數，還需看多數分布。
steps.failureEn: Inspect quorum placement, not just server count.
steps.check: 方案同時記錄失效容忍與延遲假設。
steps.checkEn: Record both failure tolerance and latency assumptions.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 容錯數只在故障假設與成員配置內成立。
knowledge.textEn: Failure counts hold within their assumptions and membership configuration.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 可用率設計需考慮共同故障域。
knowledge.textEn: Availability design must consider shared failure domains.

quiz.question: 五台都放同一機房可抵抗整個機房失效嗎？
quiz.questionEn: Can five nodes in one site survive losing that site?
options: 能，五台永遠剩三台。
能，Raft 會重建停電機房。
不能，存在共同故障域。
optionsEn: Yes; five always leave three.
Yes; Raft recreates a powered-off site.
No; the site is a shared failure domain.
quiz.explanation: 不能，存在共同故障域。 容錯數只在故障假設與成員配置內成立。
quiz.explanationEn: No; the site is a shared failure domain. Failure counts hold within their assumptions and membership configuration.

stages.title: 效能、復原與驗證
stages.description: 以延遲分布、隔離復原與故障矩陣驗證服務。
stages.descriptionEn: Verify service with latency distributions, isolated recovery and failure matrices.

steps.title: 拆解提交延遲
steps.objective: 找出網路與磁碟瓶頸。
steps.objectiveEn: Locate network and storage bottlenecks.
steps.instruction: 畫接收、日誌持久化、複製與回覆時間線；填假設延遲；比較快速平均但慢尾端磁碟；指出哪個多數完成時刻控制本次提交。
steps.instructionEn: Draw receipt, persistence, replication and response timing; add hypothetical delays; compare fast average but slow-tail storage; identify the quorum-completion time for the request.
steps.observation: 平均 IOPS 不足以描述持久寫入尾端延遲。
steps.observationEn: Average IOPS does not characterize durable-write tail latency.
steps.failure: 不把吞吐量數字直接當單次回應延遲。
steps.failureEn: Do not equate throughput with individual response latency.
steps.check: 時間帳本區分排隊、網路與儲存。
steps.checkEn: Separate queueing, network and storage time.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 共識提交需要通訊及持久儲存。
knowledge.textEn: Consensus commitment needs communication and durable storage.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 尾端延遲可影響請求與叢集穩定。
knowledge.textEn: Tail latency can affect requests and cluster stability.

quiz.question: 磁碟平均速度快就一定適合嗎？
quiz.questionEn: Does a fast average disk rate prove suitability?
options: 不一定，須量測持久化與尾端延遲。
一定，所有寫入時間相同。
一定，Raft 不使用磁碟。
optionsEn: No; measure durable writes and tail latency.
Yes; every write takes the same time.
Yes; Raft does not use disks.
quiz.explanation: 不一定，須量測持久化與尾端延遲。 共識提交需要通訊及持久儲存。
quiz.explanationEn: No; measure durable writes and tail latency. Consensus commitment needs communication and durable storage.

steps.title: 建立負載與延遲分布
steps.objective: 避免用單一平均掩蓋使用者體驗。
steps.objectiveEn: Avoid hiding user experience behind one mean.
steps.instruction: 設計讀寫比與資料大小兩項變因；為三種假設負載畫延遲分布；比較中位與尾端；同時記錄錯誤率及排隊長度。
steps.instructionEn: Vary read/write ratio and value size; draw latency distributions for three hypothetical loads; compare median and tail; record errors and queue length.
steps.observation: 吞吐上升時尾端延遲可能先惡化。
steps.observationEn: Tail latency can worsen before throughput stops increasing.
steps.failure: 只報成功請求延遲會漏掉失敗，補上錯誤率。
steps.failureEn: Include error rates rather than latency only for successful requests.
steps.check: 比較固定硬體及語義，並標明工作負載。
steps.checkEn: Keep hardware and semantics fixed and state the workload.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 效能結論與工作負載密切相關。
knowledge.textEn: Performance conclusions depend strongly on workload.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 百分位需足夠樣本與明確量測區間。
knowledge.textEn: Percentiles need adequate samples and defined measurement intervals.

quiz.question: 只比較平均延遲有何限制？
quiz.questionEn: What limits average-latency comparison?
options: 可完整描述所有使用者。
可能掩蓋慢尾端與失敗請求。
能取代所有負載說明。
optionsEn: It describes every user completely.
It can hide slow tails and failures.
It replaces workload description.
quiz.explanation: 可能掩蓋慢尾端與失敗請求。 效能結論與工作負載密切相關。
quiz.explanationEn: It can hide slow tails and failures. Performance conclusions depend strongly on workload.

steps.title: 區分快照、壓縮與備份
steps.objective: 辨認節省空間與災難復原的不同目的。
steps.objectiveEn: Separate space reduction from disaster recovery.
steps.instruction: 畫日誌、當前狀態及外部備份三區；標示歷史壓縮移除什麼；標示快照保存什麼；模擬誤刪資料後比較只剩副本與保有備份。
steps.instructionEn: Draw log, current state and external backup; mark what compaction removes; mark snapshot contents; compare accidental deletion with replicas only versus retained backup.
steps.observation: 一致複製也會把錯誤刪除傳到所有副本。
steps.observationEn: Consistent replication also propagates accidental deletion.
steps.failure: 不把三副本當作歷史備份策略。
steps.failureEn: Do not treat three replicas as a historical backup strategy.
steps.check: 說明每種機制可處理與不能處理的問題。
steps.checkEn: State what each mechanism does and cannot address.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 高可用與備份處理不同風險。
knowledge.textEn: High availability and backups address different risks.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 快照是否可用需驗證內容、版本與完整性。
knowledge.textEn: Usable snapshots require content, version and integrity checks.

quiz.question: 多副本能自動復原已提交的誤刪嗎？
quiz.questionEn: Can replicas automatically undo a committed accidental deletion?
options: 能，副本永遠保留所有歷史。
能，只需加第四台。
不能，通常都複製了同一刪除。
optionsEn: Yes; replicas retain all history forever.
Yes; just add a fourth node.
No; they usually replicated that deletion.
quiz.explanation: 不能，通常都複製了同一刪除。 高可用與備份處理不同風險。
quiz.explanationEn: No; they usually replicated that deletion. High availability and backups address different risks.

steps.title: 在隔離環境規劃復原演練
steps.objective: 證明備份可以還原而非只是存在。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate restorability rather than backup existence.
steps.instruction: 選一份教學快照及預期鍵值摘要；畫與正式服務隔離的新叢集；檢查還原後資料及客戶端 revision 假設；記錄恢復時間及資料缺口。
steps.instructionEn: Choose a teaching snapshot and expected key summary; draw a new cluster isolated from production; check restored data and client revision assumptions; record recovery time and data gap.
steps.observation: 舊快照可能使依 revision 的快取產生相容問題。
steps.observationEn: Older snapshots can cause revision-dependent cache compatibility issues.
steps.failure: 不把還原節點連回舊叢集；此步只做隔離演練計畫。
steps.failureEn: Do not reconnect restored nodes to the old cluster; plan isolated rehearsal only.
steps.check: 計畫包含完整性、資料驗證及客戶端重同步。
steps.checkEn: Include integrity, data verification and client resynchronization.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 復原建立新的邏輯叢集，需處理身分與資料歷史。
knowledge.textEn: Recovery forms a new logical cluster with identity and history considerations.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 備份時間之後的資料缺口應明確量化。
knowledge.textEn: Data gaps after the backup point should be explicit.

quiz.question: 備份檔存在就足以證明可復原嗎？
quiz.questionEn: Does a backup file's existence prove recoverability?
options: 不足，需隔離還原與資料驗證。
足夠，檔名就是完整性證據。
足夠，版本差異永遠無影響。
optionsEn: No; isolated restoration and validation are needed.
Yes; its name proves integrity.
Yes; version differences never matter.
quiz.explanation: 不足，需隔離還原與資料驗證。 復原建立新的邏輯叢集，需處理身分與資料歷史。
quiz.explanationEn: No; isolated restoration and validation are needed. Recovery forms a new logical cluster with identity and history considerations.

steps.title: 建立故障矩陣與不變量檢查
steps.titleEn: Build a failure matrix and invariant checks
steps.objective: 讓每種故障都有可反駁的預期。
steps.objectiveEn: Give each failure a falsifiable expectation.
steps.instruction: 列領導者停機、少數分割、慢磁碟及重複請求；為每列寫安全與可用預期；逐步回放；保留失敗軌跡而非只写通過。
steps.instructionEn: List leader crash, minority partition, slow disk and duplicate request; specify safety and availability expectations; replay stepwise; preserve failing traces instead of pass marks only.
steps.observation: 暫停服務可能符合預期，衝突提交則不符合。
steps.observationEn: A service pause can be expected; conflicting commits are not.
steps.failure: 不要把任何逾時都視為一致性錯誤，先分類。
steps.failureEn: Classify timeouts rather than treating each as a consistency violation.
steps.check: 每案例有觸發、觀察、不變量與恢復條件。
steps.checkEn: Each case has trigger, observation, invariant and recovery condition.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 故障測試需同時驗證安全性及進展條件。
knowledge.textEn: Failure tests check safety and progress conditions separately.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 可重現訊息軌跡比總結分數更有診斷價值。
knowledge.textEn: Reproducible message traces diagnose better than an aggregate score.

quiz.question: 失去多數後拒絕新寫入一定是設計失敗嗎？
quiz.questionEn: Is refusing writes after losing quorum necessarily a design failure?
options: 是，任何拒絕都代表資料錯誤。
不是，可能正是維持安全性的行為。
是，應改成單機立即承諾。
optionsEn: Yes; any refusal means corrupted data.
No; it can preserve safety as intended.
Yes; immediately commit on one node instead.
quiz.explanation: 不是，可能正是維持安全性的行為。 故障測試需同時驗證安全性及進展條件。
quiz.explanationEn: No; it can preserve safety as intended. Failure tests check safety and progress conditions separately.

steps.title: 比較資料庫、配置中心與協調服務
steps.objective: 了解可共用的共識核心與應用差異。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify shared consensus and application differences.
steps.instruction: 把配置中心、資料庫分片與分散鎖放成三欄；比較資料量、延遲及不變量；標出共用日誌概念；整理一頁設計與復原交付資料。
steps.instructionEn: Compare configuration, database shards and distributed locks; list data volume, latency and invariants; mark shared log concepts; assemble a one-page design and recovery dossier.
steps.observation: 共識核心相似不代表業務語義相同。
steps.observationEn: Similar consensus cores do not imply identical application semantics.
steps.failure: 不將本課程紙上 Raft 推演宣稱為可直接上線的共識實作。
steps.failureEn: Do not present paper Raft exercises as a production-ready implementation.
steps.check: 交付包含契約、故障模型、測試與衍生學習比較。
steps.checkEn: Include contract, failure model, tests and related-study comparison.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 共識是分散式系統的組件，不是完整產品。
knowledge.textEn: Consensus is a distributed-system component, not an entire product.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 應用需補足存取控制、資料生命週期及營運驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Applications add access control, data lifecycle and operational verification.

quiz.question: 三種服務共享 Raft 就代表可直接互換嗎？
quiz.questionEn: Does shared Raft make three services interchangeable?
options: 代表，共識決定所有功能。
代表，應用不需任何驗證。
不代表，資料模型與契約仍不同。
optionsEn: Yes; consensus determines every feature.
Yes; applications need no verification.
No; data models and contracts differ.
quiz.explanation: 不代表，資料模型與契約仍不同。 共識是分散式系統的組件，不是完整產品。
quiz.explanationEn: No; data models and contracts differ. Consensus is a distributed-system component, not an entire product.

places.summary:
網路安全沒有單一的製造工廠，因此本課程以 NIST 的 Gaithersburg 園區作為標準研究與公共知識的代表地點。NIST 在 2014 年發布 Cybersecurity Framework，協助組織用共同語言理解、降低及溝通風險。

框架於 2018 年更新，2024 年的 2.0 版再把適用對象明確擴展到各種組織，並新增治理功能。這段歷史提醒學徒：資安網路的建立不只是裝設備，還需要知道誰決策、要保護什麼、如何觀測事件，以及如何恢復。地圖是知識來源的定位，不是宣稱所有資安運作都集中於此。
places.summaryEn:
Cybersecurity has no single manufacturing factory, so this course uses NIST’s Gaithersburg campus as a representative location for standards research and public knowledge. NIST released the Cybersecurity Framework in 2014 to give organizations shared language for understanding, reducing, and communicating risk.

An update followed in 2018. Version 2.0 in 2024 explicitly broadened the audience to organizations of all types and added governance. The history shows that building a secure network involves decisions, assets, observation, and recovery as well as equipment. The map locates a knowledge source, not the entirety of cybersecurity operations.

places.summaryEn:
Secure boot combines hardware, firmware, specifications and operating-system mechanisms and has no single invention site. This course uses NIST’s Gaithersburg campus as a standards-research reference, showing how engineering requirements extend from protected updates to protection, detection and recovery.

NIST published BIOS Protection Guidelines in 2011 and Platform Firmware Resiliency Guidelines in 2018. The map marks the approximate research-campus location, not a demonstration-server location or the design site for every Secure Boot product.

related.transfer: 可信任服務既需要正確的軟體來源，也需要對多台機器狀態的一致認定；信任邊界應明確標示。
related.transferEn: Trustworthy services need authentic software and agreement about multi-machine state; trust boundaries must be explicit.
related.difference: 安全啟動驗證開機程式鏈；共識處理節點間的決策一致性，簽章正確不保證共識，共識也不保證韌體可信。
related.differenceEn: Secure boot authenticates a boot chain; consensus coordinates agreement among nodes. Valid signatures do not establish consensus, and consensus does not authenticate firmware.
